title: 六月 · 荷花: lotus, white gallery poster

techniques.name: Soft focus with type

blur.label: Focus blur
blur.note: The depth of field behind the lotus: every blur wider than 2 px (the far pads, the second bud, the washes), as a multiple of its own. The lotus, the near pad and the right bud stay sharp.

velvet.label: Velvet
velvet.note: Depth of the velvet noise multiplied into each soft shape. 0 lays the color flat.

pads.label: Pad haze
pads.note: Opacity of the out-of-focus pads and washes behind the lotus. 0 leaves the sheet white.

grain.label: Grain
grain.note: The film grain laid once over the plate, as a multiple of its own. 0 leaves the paint clean.

lotus.label: Lotus size
lotus.note: Size of the lotus in profile, as a multiple of the page’s own.

type.label: Type size
type.note: Size of the poster’s type, as a multiple of its own; lines keep their leading.

seed.label: Seed
seed.note: Re-rolls every seeded choice the page makes: the grain, the noise and where each mark falls. 0 is the page’s own drawing.

techniques.implementation: A soft field set behind or around crisp type and a single sharp subject. Drawn by the source page’s own code on a clock this plate drives; its strokes, marks, inks and type pass through the dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
